segments.thag1.82:1.3: Tena puttaka gacchassu, mā sokāpahato bhavā”ti.

lines: Bhummatthe hi etaṃ karaṇavacanaṃ, yasmiṃ yasmiṃ disābhāgeti attho.
Abhayānīti corabhayādīhi nibbhayāni, rogadubbhikkhabhayāni pana “subhikkhāni, sivānī”ti padadvayeneva gahitāni.
Māti paṭisedhatthe nipāto sokāpahatoti vuttaguṇarahitāni raṭṭhāni gantvā dubbhikkhabhayādijanitena sokena upahato mā bhava māhosīti attho.
Taṃ sutvā thero,“mama mātā mayhaṃ sokarahitaṭṭhānagamanaṃ āsīsati, handa mayaṃ sabbaso accantameva sokarahitaṃ ṭhānaṃ pattuṃ yuttan”ti ussāhajāto vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā nacirasseva arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
